import requests  
import psycopg2
# Утечка учётных данных базы данных  
DB_HOST = "db.internal.c"  
DB_PORT = "5432"  
DB_NAME = "db"  
DB_USER = "admin"  
DB_PASSWORD = "123456"
def connect_to_database():  
    conn = psycopg2.connect(  
        host=DB_HOST,  
        port=DB_PORT,  
        dbname=DB_NAME,  
        user=DB_USER,  
        password=DB_PASSWORD  
    )  
    return conn
# Утечка API-ключа облачного сервиса  
API_KEY = "AKIA3EEXAMPLE7KEY33333212"  
API_SECRET = "wJalrUtnFEMI/K44MDENG/fiCYEXAMPLEKEY"
def fetch_external_data():  
    headers = {  
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",  
        "X-Secret": API_SECRET  
    }  
    response = requests.get(  
        "[https://api.cloud-service.example/v1/data](https://api.cloud-service.example/v1/data)",  
        headers=headers  
    )  
    return response.json()
